newsitem.title: UK: NWE mogas still tight prompt, but buyers see hope.
newsitem.headline: NWE mogas still tight prompt, but buyers see hope.

text.p: NWE gasoline continues to be very tight for prompt material, but looks better offered from mid August onwards.
Dealers said $203.50 cif NWE was heard offered for a cargo on Aug 1-15 dates, but there were not takers.
"If you have to buy, but can delay the purchase until late in August, that is the best option," said one dealer who thought second half physical material would be securable around the low $190s.
Arbing out the region, if physical supplies were available, was not seen to be workable. Demand for high octane material was seen in New York harbour but low octane was interesting few buyers.
"With MTBE so high it doesn't work out to get low octane which then has to be blended," said one trader.
